mapper.select: select r.recipe_id, r.member_id, r.title, r.description, r.serving_size, r.main_image, r.created_at, r.difficulty, r.cooking_time, r.hit, r2.rating from recipe r, review r2 where r.recipe_id = r2.recipe_id

SELECT r.recipe_id, r.member_id, r.title, r.description, r.serving_size, TO_CHAR(r.main_image) AS main_image, r.created_at, r.difficulty, r.cooking_time, r.hit, NVL(AVG(r2.rating), 0) AS rating, rc.category_id, c.name FROM recipe r LEFT OUTER JOIN review r2 ON r.recipe_id = r2.recipe_id JOIN recipe_category rc ON r.recipe_id = rc.recipe_id JOIN category c ON rc.category_id = c.category_id
rc.category_id IN
#{cat}
GROUP BY r.recipe_id, r.member_id, r.title, r.description, r.serving_size, TO_CHAR(r.main_image), r.created_at, r.difficulty, r.cooking_time, r.hit, rc.category_id, c.name ORDER BY ${order} DESC, r.recipe_id ASC
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT recipe_id, title, description, TO_CHAR(main_image) AS main_image FROM recipe ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
mapper.insert: insert into item(name, price, description) values(#{name},#{price},#{description})
